messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — routing anomalies detected: spike in fallback routing and repeated model-variant switches. Auto-pager triggered for #incidents. Summary: ~15% increased latency, 6% request error rate to hosted API in eu-west and us-east, repeated region fallback loops.

alice oncall: I’m on it — joining. Any customer visible errors reported yet?

carla sre: seeing repeated logs: `policy_evaluate -> fallback(variant-beta) -> route-> variant-alpha -> fallback` loop. CPU/GPU churn on dedicated pools. Consequence: long tail token latencies and increased queue depth.

ben infra: rolling metrics: https://internal.metrics/redwood/routing?range=1h (link) — regional circuit breakers are tripping then immediately recovering, causing requests to hop.

dan runtime: looks like config schema migration earlier this morning removed `preferred_variant` nested field and replaced with `variant_preference` but we still accept deprecated `preferred_variant` silently. New validator defaulted missing variants to `beta` for older policies. That explains wrong model variant getting selected.

alice oncall: copy. So two problems: (1) deprecated field left in some policies -> default to beta, (2) circuit breaker oscillation when variant capacity mismatch. We should throttle fallbacks and pin routing while we fix config.

ops-bot: @alice oncall has accepted pager. Escalation to primary oncall.

sam-customer-success: Heads up — one enterprise customer (AcmeHealth) reported longer responses in EU. They're on a Dedicated plan in eu-west. I'm opening a support ticket and prepped message.

carla sre: mitigation plan proposal: 1) apply policy-level temporary override to pin variant to alpha for impacted customers; 2) disable automatic migrate-to-beta default at router level; 3) increase circuit-breaker cooldown to stop oscillation.

ben infra: I can push the router override (config service) but need approval — small risk to routing for other customers. Command I’ll run:

```
PATCH /api/configs/routing/overrides
{ "selector": "region:eu-west,tag:dedicated", "override": { "force_variant": "alpha", "temp_ttl": 1800 } }
```

alice oncall: do it. Roll it out canary to eu-west first. Notify me if any 5xx spikes.

ben infra: patch applied to eu-west canary (10% traffic). Monitoring.

laura observability: dashboards updated: cpu/gpu churn decreasing in canary nodes. Latency p95 trending down.

carla sre: pushing disable of default-beta heuristic in router config now (global safe switch). Command: `router.setFeatureFlag('implicit_beta_default', false)`

dan runtime: toggled. Validating. Also deploying a short fix to config-validator to emit errors on deprecated `preferred_variant` usage instead of silently accepting.

ops-bot: deploy started for `config-validator` -> canary.

carla sre: we need to clear existing policies that still include `preferred_variant` or translate them. Running migration script to convert `preferred_variant` -> `variant_preference` and copy the explicit values so no implicit defaulting occurs.

ben infra: migration script run on backlog policies: 312 policies updated. Took ~2m. Preview logs: `migrated: policy/enterprise/acme/42 preferred_variant: alpha -> variant_preference: alpha`

alice oncall: good. Increase cooldown for circuit-breaker in us-east and eu-west to 120s from 30s.

dan runtime: cooldown bumped in us-east, eu-west. Monitoring for oscillation. Also adding guard to routing engine: if the last 2 failovers happened within 60s, block further automatic fallback and return `503` with header `X-Routing-Hold: true` to avoid loops.

laura observability: after the overrides and cooldown bump, region failover events dropped from ~40/min to <3/min. Latency p95 improved 22% overall in eu-west.

sam-customer-success: updated AcmeHealth support ticket: short mitigation applied and engineers monitoring. They asked for a concise postmortem once stable.

customer message snippet (sam-customer-success): "We're aware of increased latency earlier today and have applied a temporary routing pin for your region. No data loss. We'll follow up with a technical summary."

alice oncall: quick status: 1) immediate customer impact reduced, 2) migration scripts done, 3) validator now errors on deprecated fields, 4) circuit-breaker guard in place. Next: rollback temporary overrides after 30m of stability and schedule postmortem.

ben infra: removing canary after 20m stable, then gradually remove full override after 30m stability window.

ops-bot: Reminder: please run `incident-annotation` after resolution: `incident annotate 1799998000 --severity P2 --cause routing-policy-schema-migration`

carla sre: heading into post-incident checklist: assign owner for postmortem, collect timeline, collect config change that caused migration, and update runbooks to include validator errors in pre-deploy gate.

evan product: we should notify customers on status page and add note about config migration causing unexpected defaults. I can draft message with compliance language.

alice oncall: setting owner: carla for postmortem. Action items:
- carla: timeline + mitigation steps (due EOD)
- dan: patch to validator deploy to prod and unit-tests to prevent silent defaulting (due today)
- ben: add safe-mode toggle to routing service + runbook entry (due tomorrow)
- laura: dashboard alert for routing oscillation SLO (due tomorrow)
- sam-customer-success: customer comms draft and send after PM review (due today)

carla sre: noted. I'll start timeline now. Quick logs for timeline:
```
08:12:13 config-service: schema migration applied (v2)
08:13:02 router: implicit defaulting to beta for missing fields
08:17:10 circuit-breaker trips eu-west pool-3
08:17:30 failover triggered -> variant-beta
08:18:05 failover back -> variant-alpha
08:18:30 repeat -> loop
08:20:00 oncall auto-pager fired
08:22:10 override applied (eu-west canary)
08:25:45 validator feature flag toggled
08:28:00 migration script run
08:35:00 cooldown bumped
08:45:30 oscillation dropped to normal
```

alice oncall: declaring INCIDENT: mitigated. Keeping thread open for postmortem notes and final customer message.

ops-bot: Pager cleared. Thanks to responders: :tada: 

carla sre: quick retrospective notes inline:
- root cause: schema migration accepted deprecated `preferred_variant` silently and validation/defaulting logic assigned `beta` by default.
- contributing: routing engine lacked protective guard against rapid fallback oscillation; circuit-breaker cooldown too short.
- detection: auto-pager triggered by failover spike; good coverage.
- mitigation: temporary override pinned variants, disabled implicit default, increased cooldown, migrated policies, added guard.
- action items: validator strict-mode, runbook update, add preflight test for schema migrations, add e2e for routing default behavior.

evan product: will coordinate customer-facing postmortem language and link to the technical one.

alice oncall: thanks everyone. I'll follow-up tomorrow with a summary and link to the postmortem doc.

carla sre: adding doc link (draft): https://internal.docs/incidents/1799998000-routing-schema-migration-mitigation (will update after writeup)

sam-customer-success: sent proactive message to AcmeHealth. They acknowledged: "thanks for the quick action, appreciate the update".

laura observability: leaving monitoring watches for 24h and will alert if oscillation reappears.

alice oncall: closing operational thread now. Postmortem draft due EOD.

ops-bot: Thread archived by oncall-bot.
